title: Contract Pricing Agreement Final Rebate Check: Unexpired Term Administration Holdback
content:
# Unexpired term administration holdback — Contract Pricing Agreement

**Rule.** On a final rebate check of a Contract Pricing Agreement terminated early, the administration holdback follows the whole months of the term that remained after the termination effective date, counted to the expiration date shown on the agreement record. Whole months between two dates are the difference in calendar months between them, less one when the later date's day of the month is earlier than the earlier date's.

| Whole months remaining | Administration holdback |
|---|---|
| 6 or more | A flat 350.00 |
| At least 1 and fewer than 6 | 50.00 for each remaining month |
| None | No administration holdback |

The amount is held back from the unpaid rebate balance before the final check's floor at 0.00, its rounding to the cent and its minimum payout test are applied; what is held back stays in the rebate balance.

Worked cases (hypothetical dates): termination effective 10 March with the term expiring 9 June: 3 calendar months, less one because the 9th is earlier than the 10th, so 2 whole months and a holdback of 100.00. Termination effective 10 March with expiry 31 December: 9 whole months and a flat 350.00.
